name: QuantumGS
definition: A hybrid quantum-classical framework that integrates Variational Quantum Circuits (VQCs) into the 3D Gaussian Splatting pipeline to capture high-frequency view-dependent effects (sharp reflections, transparency) by mapping viewing directions onto the Bloch sphere.
summary: QuantumGS is a hybrid framework using Variational Quantum Circuits to model view-dependent effects, distinguishing itself by mapping directions to the Bloch sphere for higher expressivity.
